answer: Standing is a meadow that only grows where a vine of real work has taken root: each epoch the network picks a random horizon of the meadow and asks its owner to show the vine's newest growth — a small task chained to that identity's key and history, due within the hour. A fake meadow has no vine to show, so its horizon stays bare; each extra fake costs a full fresh meadow of weeks of real, verifiable work, and no operator can tend a thousand meadows at once.
